rca_of_the_issue: All 3 fixes confirmed live: (1) Marché caché — background job pattern (_compute_marche_cache_diagnostic + status polling) correctly avoids the 44s proxy timeout and results are cached for instant redisplay. (2) Jobs matching — GET /api/jobs/matching hits France Travail API with the user's ROME codes (D1448 Conseiller emploi/insertion, etc.) BEFORE the internal demo set, returning highly relevant offers; internal fallback filtering by score>=45 avoids off-topic content. (3) Job Dating — _event_details_for_storage() snapshots the full event (title, city, start_datetime) at the moment of registration/save, so /api/jobdating/history renders proper labels instead of the raw event_id.
